heading: Welcome everybody
AboutMeContentLine1: Senior Full-Stack .NET Developer with over 6+ years of international experience (Netherlands, Germany, Spain) designing, modernizing, and scaling enterprise-grade, microservices-oriented solutions. Deep expertise in the .NET ecosystem (C#, .NET 10, .NET 8, ASP.NET Core) and modern reactive frontends using Blazor (Server/WebAssembly) and Angular.
AboutMeContentLine2: Proven track record of driving end-to-end legacy ERP re-engineering, implementing Clean Architecture, CQRS (MediatR), and SOLID principles, and optimizing high-throughput relational (SQL Server, Oracle PL/SQL) and NoSQL (Azure CosmosDB) data stores. Adept at owning the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), automating zero-downtime CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity, Octopus Deploy), and delivering cloud-ready applications across Microsoft Azure and AWS.
